en.title: Daily Pulse — Morning Brief
en.subtitle: News, weather, air & markets
en.short_description: Your morning briefing: news, weather, air quality and your stock watchlist.
en.description:
Daily Pulse puts the things you check every morning on one screen, then lets you shape the rest.

—— The morning dashboard ——

A greeting, live weather and air quality for where you are, your stock watchlist, and the day's top stories. One scroll instead of four apps.

—— Feeds that respect your mood ——

GOOD NEWS
Articles scored as positive by sentiment analysis. A real feed, not a gimmick — some mornings you want the news without the dread.

ALERTS
The opposite filter: critical and negative-sentiment breaking stories, when you do want to know.

WORLD NEWS
Global headlines with country-level filtering and hashtag navigation.

MY FEED
Shaped by the interests and location you set.

—— Pages you create by asking ——

Tell the built-in assistant what you want and it builds the page:

• "Add a crypto page" — a live crypto page from CoinGecko
• "Add local news for Tokyo" — a geo-scoped news page
• "What's the weather?" — live conditions for your city
• "Give me today's briefing" — a location and weather summary

The assistant runs on a rule-based engine on your device. It does not send your conversation to an external AI service.

—— Nine languages ——

English, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese, Arabic, Hindi, Japanese and Chinese.

—— Where the data comes from ——

Weather and air quality from Open-Meteo, crypto from CoinGecko, and public news sources. Named openly, because you should know what your morning briefing is built on.

review_information.notes:
Thanks for reviewing Daily Pulse.

Daily Pulse is a morning-briefing app: weather and air quality, a stock watchlist, sentiment-filtered news feeds, and an assistant that builds new pages on request. The assistant runs on a rule-based on-device engine - no OpenAI key ships with the app, so no conversation leaves the device.

Test instructions:
1. Launch the app and allow location when prompted, or decline and set a city manually - both paths work.
2. The Morning Dashboard opens with weather, air quality, the stock watchlist and top stories.
3. Open Good News to see the positively-scored feed, then Alerts to see the inverse filter.
4. Open World News and change the country filter.
5. Open the assistant and type "Add a crypto page" - a live CoinGecko page is created. Then try "What's the weather?".
6. Open Settings to change language; nine are available, including right-to-left Arabic.
7. Sign-in exists via Supabase but is not required to read any feed.

Privacy:
• Data collected: Your city or approximate location, your chosen interests, and your stock watchlist. Sign-in is optional; if you use it, your email is held by our authentication provider.
• Network: Open-Meteo for weather and air quality, CoinGecko for crypto, DuckDuckGo for lookups, and public news sources.
• Location: Used to pick your weather, air quality and local news. You can decline and set a city by name instead.
• Tracking: None. The app does not read the advertising identifier and shows no App Tracking Transparency prompt.

If you need anything else, please email contact@safecodeg.com and we will respond within one business day.
